basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Masters in Bioinformatics / Biochemistry / Computational Biology

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form in the proforma at Annexure-I.
Address the application to the Director, ICAR-CIFRI, Barrackpore.
Attach detailed bio-data with a recent passport size photograph and self-attested copies of marksheets, certificates, age proof and experience certificate.
Send the scanned application and documents to [email protected].
Send within 21 days from the date of publication of the Vacancy Notice in the newspaper; late applications will be summarily rejected.
Email it on or before 7 December 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview. Candidates already working should produce a no objection certificate from their employer/supervisor at the time of interview. Original documents must be produced at the time of interview / joining. Selected candidates will be stationed at Barrackpore or at sites as required from time to time. Candidates should regularly visit https://www.cifri.res.in and check their email for updates. The Director's decision will be final and binding on all aspects.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CIFRI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NMCG (NIH Roorkee)-10181(1)/2026-Adm.II-(Part-2) (e-459170) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICAR-CIFRI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters in Bioinformatics / Biochemistry / Computational Biology Age limit: 21 to 45 years Age relaxation: Relaxation as per rules Other conditions: Only Indian citizens are eligible for applying for engagement.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ICAR-CIFRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not send the prescribed application form to the email will not be allowed to appear in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: 01 (One) year OR co-terminus with the project, extendable for two more years (01 year at a time) subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Maximum duration of engagement of YP in the ICAR is three years (1+1+1). Purely contractual; no right/claim for regular appointment at ICAR-CIFRI at any point of time.

content_sections.heading: How Will ICAR-CIFRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of academic performance, experience etc. Interview Shortlisting on academic performance, experience etc. and approved criteria as per job requirement. List of shortlisted candidates sent to their e-mail address. Date, time and venue of interview informed through e-mail only. Application form asks the preferred mode of interview: Offline / Virtual.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form as per Annexure-I with recent passport size photograph Detailed bio-data Self-attested copies of marksheets, certificates and age proof document Certificate / Provisional Certificate with final year mark-sheets for Graduation and Post Graduation (mandatory) Experience certificate and other credentials Copies of PAN and Aadhaar

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIFRI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form in the proforma at Annexure-I. Address the application to the Director, ICAR-CIFRI, Barrackpore. Attach detailed bio-data with a recent passport size photograph and self-attested copies of marksheets, certificates, age proof and experience certificate. Send the scanned application and documents to [email protected] . Send within 21 days from the date of publication of the Vacancy Notice in the newspaper; late applications will be summarily rejected. Email it on or before 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview. Candidates already working should produce a no objection certificate from their employer/supervisor at the time of interview. Original documents must be produced at the time of interview / joining. Selected candidates will be stationed at Barrackpore or at sites as required from time to time. Candidates should regularly visit https://www.cifri.res.in and check their email for updates. The Director's decision will be final and binding on all aspects.
